From their feed

The stand on 162

Locally owned, and staying put.

CLINK opened in 2023 as a drive-thru and walk-up stand on Highway 162 — the kind of place people pull into on the way out of South Prairie and again on the way home.

Earlier this year the crew posted what they called a bittersweet announcement: the mobile coffee trailer was being retired. Their own line settled it — “While Clink Coffee Co. isn't going anywhere, we are officially saying goodbye to our mobile coffee trailer.” One window, one crew, every morning.

The name is the whole idea. Two cups touching — one iced, one hot — drawn right into the logo, and printed on the heart sticker that goes out on every order.

Find the window

Two ways in: pull up, or walk up.

  1. Coming down 162. The stand sits right on the highway through South Prairie — drive-thru lane on one side, walk-up window on the other.
  2. Order ahead if you're in a hurry. CLINK takes orders online through Toast, so it's waiting when you get there.
  3. Say hi on Instagram. The monthly favorites board and the day's specials get posted there first.
